purpose: Admission screen for meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo in the query_checker role, on LIVE-QUERY-shaped probes, after the r25 concentration-bound stop established that gemma-4's checker runaway rate is prompt-content-dependent (4.3% per call on live queries vs 0-of-96 on pilot-composed probes). An operational blocker screen, not an error-rate certification.

owner_approval.channel: Claude Code session 3cf5f3a5-3285-4fbd-9cf1-16e43f5458c5, decision menu of 2026-08-28
owner_approval.content: screen Llama as checker on live-query probes including all known trigger prompts; on pass, amendment 9 + fresh identity + rerun; automatic fallback to stop-and-report if the screen fails

codex_basis: rejudge/phase3_v3_codex_checker_options_consult_2026-08-28.md: ruling B > C > A with blockers: screen the exact production configuration; require 0-of-96 valid parsed completions plus successful completion on every known trigger; freeze a deterministic judge-balanced selection before executing Llama; no prompt, parser, or threshold changes after seeing outputs; predeclare the judge-origin disparity diagnostic; treat the stopped identity as terminal; if Llama fails, stop rather than shop for another checker

probe_bank.construction: every gemma-4 checker call actually executed across the two sealed N=2 identities, recomposed deterministically from the frozen checker system prompt, the frozen user template, offline-composed candidates, and the live judge query from the sealed call caches; every entry verified byte-exactly against a production request hash (117 via call-cache request_sha256, 6 runaway calls via ledger request_fields_sha256 with gemma's pinned streaming flag); zero unmatched
probe_bank.evidence_reuse_boundary: sealed-archive queries are development evidence for screening only; no predecessor verdict, outcome, or measurement row is reused in any successor measurement

selection: ALL 6 verified runaway-trigger probes plus a deterministic judge-balanced complement to 96 total: within each originating-judge stratum, entries sorted by probe_id ascending, stride-sampled to 45 per judge from the completed calls (90 total), frozen before any Llama call is dispatched

production_configuration.system_prompt_and_user_template: the frozen phase-2 checker artifacts, unchanged (phase2_checker_frozen_config_2026-07-23, phase2_checker_validation_design_2026-07-18)
production_configuration.temperature_and_seed: the frozen checker configuration's decoding values, unchanged
production_configuration.max_tokens_note: the frozen base query_checker budget; Llama is non-reasoning so no floor applies, exactly what the successor role-limits artifact will pin

acceptance: PASS requires all 96 probes evaluated with 0 invalid (invalid = empty OR rejudge.phase2_query_gate.parse_checker_output raising MalformedCheckerOutput on the verbatim text OR finish_reason != stop), including successful parsed completion on ALL 6 runaway triggers; a probe that cannot complete within 3 bounded transport retries makes the batch INCOMPLETE, never a pass; any failure = stop-and-report per the owner's approved fallback
post_screen_freeze: no prompt, parser, or threshold change is permitted after Llama outputs are seen; the screen result feeds only the admit/stop decision
predeclared_canary_diagnostic: the successor canary's audit reports checker rejection rates separately by originating judge; a large Llama-vs-Qwen acceptance disparity blocks interpretation of the treatment effect (exact comparison pre-registered in amendment 9)

spend.estimate_usd: ~0.2 (96 calls, ~1-2k prompt tokens, 16 completion tokens at Llama serverless rates)
spend.accounting: out-of-canary-ledger screening per the amendment-4 precedent, reported in the successor authorization
